name: Get A Puppy! 🐶
desc:
🐶 IT’S YOUR BIRTHDAY... AND TODAY YOU GET A PUPPY! 🎁

There’s just one problem: getting a puppy is NEVER as easy as it sounds. 😅

Can you make it to the end and meet your new best friend?

Which one will you get? Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary... or something SECRET? ✨

🌳 Show off your puppy at the Dog Park and hang out with friends.
📖 Collect every breed in your Pup-Dex!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for new puppies and updates!

llm.loop: wait/queue through obstacles to get your birthday puppy -> receive a random-rarity puppy -> show off at the dog park -> repeat to fill the Pup-Dex
llm.objectives: get a puppy and collect every breed
llm.instructions: make it to the end to get a puppy, show it at the dog park, collect every breed
unique: waiting-line game with a random puppy reward
llm.thumbnails: cute girl avatar hugging a puppy with 'Get A Puppy' logo and doghouse
llm.complexity_notes: linear path/queue, puppy models, small dog park
